products.name: Vehicle Wrap Prints
products.details:
Printed wrap — full colour, with matching laminate
- 3M IJ180: $8.00 per sq ft
- Arlon: $6.50 per sq ft
Cut vinyl decals — one colour, weeded and pre-masked
- 3M: $14.00 per sq ft
- Arlon: $12.00 per sq ft
Minimum order $60. Maximum height per panel: 52 in for prints, 49 in for cut decals. Production 3–4 business days.
products.filePrep:
# Printed wraps
Set the artwork up at full size (or to scale), in CMYK, at 100–150 DPI at full size.
Split the design into panels no taller than 52 in and place the panels side by side in the file — not stacked.
Add 2 in bleed on every outside edge and about 1 in overlap where two panels meet.
Convert fonts to outlines, embed linked images, then export a PDF (preferred), AI, EPS or high-resolution TIFF.
# Cut vinyl decals
Vector artwork only (AI, EPS, SVG or PDF) with fonts converted to outlines — no photos or gradients.
Give every shape an outline (stroke) in the same colour as its fill, so there is no white edge and thin parts cut cleanly.
One colour per layer, every piece no taller than 49 in.
No mirroring needed: we cut, weed and pre-mask the decals ready to apply.
